title: Near-linear Glauber mixing below the full ferromagnetic field threshold
description: Unrefereed written-proof candidate for O(n log²(2n) log(1/epsilon)) worst-start uniformly random-site heatbath mixing throughout the stated strict heterogeneous ferromagnetic field regime, with unrestricted degrees and no uniform individual minimum-mass assumption. Combines imported influence and scalar-field entropy results with an integrable covariance rate and deterministic trimming. Includes relaxation and finite-horizon coupling consequences and explicit limits of direct entropy approaches. Finite exact checks are diagnostics, not formal verification or external peer review.
